Wren turns to Ash, eyes bright with curiosity, and asks what lies hidden in the tales of Ember Vale. "The rocky islets south of Corvane are indeed a place of mystery and intrigue. Ash gestures toward the distant southern sky, trying to turn the conversation to the rocky islets, a question hanging unspoken between them.

Ash listens, their gaze steady, then settles back against the barn wall, waiting. Ash answers Wren about the rocky islets south of Corvane, speaking slowly, choosing each word like a stone laid on a path. The wind stirs the straw at their feet, and the two of them stand in the quiet gap between what was said and what remains unspoken.
